name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::*-exports/* (leading-wildcard bucket name) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression + boundary: the bucket-name head begins with '*', so this matches EVERY bucket whose name ends in '-exports', account-wide - an unbounded, naming-based set, not a single named bucket. FAIL CLOSED: a leading '*' on the bucket segment is broad. Contrast the negative boundary dataexfil-scoped-arn-not-broad (arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/prefix/*), where the bucket head is a CONCRETE name and only the trailing key is wildcarded - that stays quiet. DATA-EXFIL must fire; CLI must exit non-zero.
